name: general transcription factor IIi
pathways: positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: GTF2I encodes general transcription factor II-I. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in transcription by RNA polymerase II and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

function.text: GTF2I encodes general transcription factor II-I. It interacts with the basal transcription machinery by coordinating the formation of a multiprotein complex at the C-FOS promoter, and linking specific signal responsive activator complexes. It promotes the formation of stable high-order complexes of SRF and PHOX1 and interacts cooperatively with PHOX1 to promote serum-inducible transcription of a reporter gene deriven by the C-FOS serum response element (SRE). It functions as a coregulator for USF1 by binding independently two promoter elements, a pyrimidine-rich initiator (Inr) and an upstream E-box.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving GTF2I have been reported in thymoma.
